title: Live Pet Health Guarantee Schedule of Cover
content:
Every live animal sold by Tailwise Pet Co. comes with the Live Pet Health Guarantee, written as one of six guarantee types. The guarantee period is the number of calendar days after purchase during which a live animal that dies or falls ill is covered. The figures below are fixed per guarantee type.

## Part A: period and claim limits

| Guarantee type | Guarantee period (calendar days after purchase) | Claims allowed per covered purchase | Animals of the purchase one claim may cover |
|---|---|---|---|
| Freshwater Fish Guarantee | 30 | 1 | 12 |
| Saltwater Fish & Invertebrate Guarantee | 14 | 1 | 6 |
| Live Coral Guarantee | 7 | 1 | 3 |
| Small Animal Guarantee | 14 | 1 | 2 |
| Bird Guarantee | 14 | 1 | 2 |
| Reptile & Amphibian Guarantee | 14 | 1 | 2 |

## Part B: dead on arrival

Where the schedule shows "Yes", an animal dead within the dead-on-arrival window (hours after purchase) is refunded in full regardless of water test. Where it shows "No", the guarantee type has no dead-on-arrival full refund and its window is 0 hours.

| Guarantee type | Dead-on-arrival full refund | Dead-on-arrival window (hours after purchase) |
|---|---|---|
| Freshwater Fish Guarantee | No | 0 |
| Saltwater Fish & Invertebrate Guarantee | No | 0 |
| Live Coral Guarantee | No | 0 |
| Small Animal Guarantee | Yes | 48 |
| Bird Guarantee | Yes | 48 |
| Reptile & Amphibian Guarantee | Yes | 48 |

## Part C: what and whom the cover reaches

| Guarantee type | Invertebrates bought with the fish are covered | Feeder animals and live food are outside the guarantee | Guarantee transfers with the animal to another person |
|---|---|---|---|
| Freshwater Fish Guarantee | No | Yes | No |
| Saltwater Fish & Invertebrate Guarantee | Yes | Yes | No |
| Live Coral Guarantee | No | Yes | No |
| Small Animal Guarantee | No | Yes | No |
| Bird Guarantee | No | Yes | No |
| Reptile & Amphibian Guarantee | No | Yes | No |

## Notes to the schedule

1. **Claims and animals.** Each covered purchase allows one claim, and that one claim may cover no more animals of the purchase than Part A allows. Hypothetical illustration: a Freshwater Fish Guarantee purchase of 20 fish permits a single claim, and that claim may cover at most 12 of the 20 fish; a Bird Guarantee purchase permits a single claim covering at most 2 birds.
2. **Dead-on-arrival boundary.** Hypothetical illustration for a Small Animal Guarantee: an animal found dead 47 hours after purchase falls within the 48-hour window; an animal found dead 49 hours after purchase does not.
3. **Feeder animals and live food** are outside the Live Pet Health Guarantee under every guarantee type.
4. **New owners.** Under every guarantee type the guarantee does not transfer with the animal to another person.
